Cliopatria 'Kingdom of Sobrarbe' (825-829) is a legendary kingdom whose cells equal the County of Aragon shape: drop the row or merge it into county-of-aragon (which starts 807).

Cliopatria 'Kingdom of Asturias' 911-925 shapes are Castile; replaced by the province of Asturias and the state ends 924. The east (Castile, Alava, La Rioja, Cantabria) is unowned in Cliopatria 911-960: kingdom-of-leon / kingdom-of-castile dossiers should start earlier.

Emirate of Cordoba and Caliphate of Cordoba are one Umayyad state: emirate ends 929 (caliphate proclaimed 16 January 929) and the caliphate-of-cordoba dossier should treat 929 as a rename, not a new state; Cliopatria's Emirate shapes 898-935 draw all al-Andalus although the page says the emir's power c. 900 did not extend beyond Cordoba itself (the dossier models a collapse to a 90 km circle, confidence 2, then dated reconquests 913-922).

Pamplona and Navarre are one kingdom on Wikipedia (Q200262, 824-1841): kingdom-of-pamplona covers 824-1076; Navarre restored 1134, Cliopatria Navarre rows from 1139 belong to another group's kingdom-of-navarre dossier; the reviewer may merge.

Cliopatria's Kingdom of Aragon (1015-1168) grows from county-of-aragon and overlaps Pamplona's Sobrarbe/Ribagorza gains from 1015; the kingdom-of-aragon dossier (another group) must reconcile with kingdom-of-pamplona's 1015-1076 keyframes.
